name: Tumblebrew
lore: A runaway porcelain teapot whose mischievous woodland brew is delicious to friends and bitter to monsters.

primary.name: Spout Shot
primary.description: Pour two curling tea drops for 9 damage each. Hits poison for 1 damage per second over 4s; poison refreshes rather than stacks.

secondary.name: Tumble Pour
secondary.description: Hop three times along a 240-unit path in 0.9s, leaving three 3s poison puddles. Landing hits deal 12 damage once per foe; puddles poison for 1 damage/s. Walls stop you; you remain vulnerable.

special.name: Bitter Bloom
special.description: Place a giant brewing cup up to 220 units ahead. After 1s it erupts across a 150-unit radius for 38 damage and poison (2 damage/s for 4s). Walls block the splash.

passive: Fresh Pour: landing on a poisoned foe restores 2 health, once per different foe per Tumble Pour, up to 6 health.

technique.name: Ember Infusion
technique.description: Spout Shot applies burn instead of poison (same 1 damage/s for 4s). Its cooldown is 15% longer; other attacks stay poisonous.

final_technique.name: Porcelain Crescents
final_technique.description: Two porcelain crescents curve back for 26 per leg with mild poison. Trades the stationary Bitter Bloom for moving cuts.

attack.name: Porcelain Crescents
attack.description: Two porcelain crescents curve back for 26 per leg with mild poison. Trades the stationary Bitter Bloom for moving cuts.
